leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a custom useToggle composable function that returns reactive state and a toggle method
Initialize a reactive boolean state variable within the useToggle composable
Implement a toggle function that reverses the boolean state when called
Bind the useToggle composable to a Vue component's setup function
Render the current toggle state in the component template using interpolation
Control the toggle state by wiring a button click event to the toggle method
Manipulate the toggle state by adding reset and set methods to the composable
Integrate multiple independent toggle instances within a single component
